question: do the two banked refav1 checkpoints emit DIFFERENT trajectories on the same 140 windows?
note: the two checkpoint FILES differ in size, so they are different weights; both store step=1000 (the counter restarts at the epoch boundary)
reading: cl, cl_navshuf, ha and ol are BYTE-IDENTICAL across the two checkpoints on all 140 windows, while cl_oraclegoal — the only arm whose goal is not the degenerate imagined one — moves up to 2.70 m. The deployed plan is therefore NOT a property of these particular weights. Independent corroboration of D-REFAV1-COST-SURFACE / D-REFAV1-GOAL-DEGENERATE, measured here off the banked dumps with no model loaded.
